visual_anatomy.title: A large three-line headline frames a household-cost question; its two-word noun phrase is held inside a broad lavender hand-rendered capsule.
visual_anatomy.layout: A single large United States map dominates the page, with direct place-value labels, a dense northeastern label cluster, a continuous colour legend, and a small source/date footer.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline and stated population condition → map and place labels → continuous legend → source and date note.
visual_anatomy.typography: Very large bold sans headline, rough display emphasis inside the capsule, bold currency labels, and compact sans place/source text.
visual_anatomy.colour: A lavender-to-aqua-to-pink continuous scale fills the map regions and is repeated in the bottom legend; type and boundaries remain dark for legibility.
visual_anatomy.surface: White ground, muted grey atmospheric shadow around the map, thin region boundaries, and almost no decorative chrome beyond the headline tag.
visual_anatomy.modules: One geographic measurement field, direct geographic labels, a shared continuous legend, and a compact framing/footer stack.
visual_anatomy.density: High geographic density, especially in the northeast, mitigated by direct labels and an explicit scale.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: See a location-based difference quickly while retaining the actual values and the scale behind the colour encoding.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Co-locate a single place-based measure with geography, direct values, and a shared scale so the reader does not have to reconcile a map with a separate table.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when geography is materially relevant, the measurement definition and date are credible, and a map communicates the relationship more clearly than a ranked table.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s household framing, country map, city values, calculation methodology, legend range, headline cadence, lavender hand tag, or visual treatment of the regions.

claim_boundary.note: The visual contains numerical values, a source line, methodology language, and a date, but the corpus does not independently verify its data, calculation, or caption association.
